label: Q2 2026
method: Top 5 shareholders per ticker. Institutions: SEC Form 13F-HR/HR-A information tables for the quarter (see data/shareholding.json for the audited totals); SOLE rows attribute to their reporter in full and each shared-discretion block counts once, at the largest amount any participant reported, attributed to the participant who reported the largest amount (DFND reporter wins ties). Large investment complexes file through several separate entities, so one complex can appear on several rows. Insiders: each holder's most recent Form 4 (direct + indirect shares owned after the transaction); holdings are as of that filing, which may be after the quarter end, and holders who only ever filed a Form 3 initial statement do not appear. Where the summed insider total exceeds 50% of shares outstanding the same block is reported by several related holders, so no insider total is shown for that company (the top holders are each real filings). Public is the aggregate remainder (100% minus institutions minus insiders) — no named public holders exist in any filing.
